dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Scan your disk and let AI pick what is safe.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Review what was found and decide what gets removed.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.subtitle: Cleaned files are kept here instead of being deleted.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: A record of every cleanup you have run.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Set a target or ask in plain language.

dash.readyTitle: Scan the system, the gain is ready
dash.readyText: Run a scan to start. AI evaluates caches, temporary files and duplicates, then tells you which ones can be removed safely.
dash.afterClean: Cleanup finished. Run a new scan to refresh these numbers.
dash.reclaimTitleFor: AI is asking for approval on {size}
dash.reclaimText: {count} categories passed the safety threshold (confidence ≥ 80%). Risky groups (old downloads, large files, duplicates) were left out.

empty.insights: The AI assessment appears here once a scan is done.
empty.noData: No data yet. Run a scan.
empty.catWaitingText: Start a scan from the dashboard and the categories are listed here.
empty.noMatchText: Change the filter or the search term.
empty.vaultText: Files moved to quarantine are listed here and can be restored.
empty.historyText: Every completed cleanup is recorded here.

switch.deepTitle: Deep scan also looks for large files and duplicates (takes longer)

cat.moreFiles: +{count} more files (only the largest are shown)

user_temp.name: User Temporary Files
user_temp.desc: Leftovers from installers and updates, temporary files that applications leave behind.

windows_temp.name: Windows Temporary Folder
windows_temp.desc: System-wide temporary files. Locked ones are skipped.

browser_cache.name: Browser Caches
browser_cache.desc: Page images and code caches. Safe to remove; sites open slightly slower afterwards.

windows_update.name: Windows Update Leftovers
windows_update.desc: Downloaded files of installed updates. Administrator permission may be required.

thumbnails.name: Thumbnail Cache
thumbnails.desc: File previews shown in Explorer. They are rebuilt automatically.

prefetch.name: Prefetch Files
prefetch.desc: A cache that speeds up application launches. Deleting it slows down the first launches.

crash_dumps.name: Crash Dumps
crash_dumps.desc: Error records of crashed applications. Unnecessary unless you are debugging.

recycle_bin.name: Recycle Bin
recycle_bin.desc: Files you sent to the Recycle Bin. Once emptied they cannot be recovered.

downloads_old.name: Old Downloads
downloads_old.desc: Downloads unchanged for more than {days} days. What they contain is your call.

large_files.name: Large Files
large_files.desc: Files larger than {size}. The biggest gains, but they need the most attention.

duplicates.name: Duplicate Files
duplicates.desc: Files with identical content. Deleting one copy is safe, deleting all of them is not.

toast.partialText: This category has {count} more files that are not shown; selecting files one by one only processes what is listed.
toast.noSuggestionText: AI found no category above the safety threshold.
toast.aiSavedText: The new provider is used from your next question onwards.

vault.note: Files in quarantine are not deleted, they are moved. You can restore them at any time.
vault.restoreText: {count} files ({size}) will be moved back to their original locations.
vault.purgeText: {count} files ({size}) will be removed from quarantine for good.
vault.purgeWarn: This cannot be undone. Files are erased from the disk and need a recovery tool.

asst.title: Goal-based smart selection
asst.desc: Tell how much space you want to free; AI reaches the target by picking only from safe categories. Risky groups are never auto-selected.
asst.greeting: Hello. After a scan I can answer questions like “what can I delete?” or “what takes the most space?”.

pick.reached: Target reached; the selection contains only safe categories.
pick.shortfall: {size} of the target could not be met — the rest sits in risky groups.
pick.nothing: AI found no category above the safety threshold. Enable deep scan and try again, or review the categories manually.
pick.needScan: You need to run a scan first.

ai.title: AI provider
ai.lede: Let a real language model produce the answers instead of the rule engine. Enter your OpenAI key and pick a model; the key is stored with the operating system's encryption vault and is never sent back to the interface. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.
ai.keySaved: A key is stored. Type a new one to replace it, or use “Remove key”.
ai.keyEnv: The key is read from an environment variable. You can override it by typing a new key here.
ai.keyCreate: No key added yet. You can create one at platform.openai.com.
ai.removeText: The key is deleted from disk and the assistant falls back to the rule engine.

clean.title: Cleanup behaviour
clean.quarantineText: Files are not deleted; they are kept so they can be restored.
clean.deleteText: Cannot be undone. Files do not go to the Recycle Bin either.
clean.deepText: Large files and duplicates are searched on every scan.
clean.autoText: Risk-free groups are checked when a scan finishes.
clean.motionText: Simplifies animations so the app stays smooth on low-end hardware.

lang.title: Language
lang.text: Interface language. Leave it on “System default” to follow Windows.
lang.fallback: Some languages are not translated yet; those screens appear in English.

about.title: Application info
about.safety: Deletion only happens under the roots defined by the scan categories. Windows, Program Files and the Recycle Bin's system area are protected by a deny-list compiled into the code.

provider.noteOpenAiNoKey: OpenAI selected but no API key yet — add one in Settings
provider.noteOllamaDown: Ollama is not reachable — using rules

status.modelsFound: {count} models found — pick one from the list.
status.noModels: No usable chat model was found for this key.
status.modelsFailed: Could not fetch the model list.
status.keyNotSaved: The key could not be saved, so the model list was not fetched.
status.keyNotSavedShort: The key could not be saved.
status.keyRemoveFailed: The key could not be removed.

ai.noKey: No OpenAI API key was entered. Add one under Settings → AI provider.
ai.timeout: The request timed out. Check the endpoint address and your connection.
ai.emptyReply: The model returned an empty reply.
ai.noModel: The model name is empty. Choose a model first.
ai.askEmpty: Type a question; for example “what can I delete?”
ai.systemPrompt: You are the advisor of reMona (AICleaner), a Windows disk cleaner. Answer briefly, clearly and in at most four sentences. Never recommend deleting system files; for risky categories leave the choice to the user. Rely only on the scan data provided.

http.e401: The API key was rejected (401). Check the key.
http.e403: This key is not allowed to access the requested model (403).
http.e429: Rate limit or quota exceeded (429). Try again later.
http.e413: The request body is too large (413).
http.e5xx: Error on the provider side ({status}). Try again later.

reason.prefetch: The gain is small (usually under 200 MB) and deleting it slows down application launches.
reason.downloads: The content may be yours. AI only suggests; you pick the files.
reason.recycle: These are files you already chose to delete; emptying is irreversible.
reason.duplicates: The original of each group is kept; only the extra copies are marked.
reason.browser: Session data and passwords are not affected, only the cache is cleared.
reason.large: Size alone is not a reason to delete. Look at what the file is.

insight.cleanText: No files worth cleaning were found in the scanned locations.
insight.biggestText: {size} can be reclaimed — {percent}% of all junk. AI confidence {confidence}%.
insight.diskFullText: {drive} is {percent}% full, only {free} free. Prioritise the recommended cleanup.
insight.safeText: {size} of caches and temporary files; removing them causes no data loss ({count} categories).
insight.riskyText: {names} may contain your personal files. AI never adds them to the default selection; delete only what you have reviewed.
insight.prefetchText: {size} frees space but slows the next launches. AI scores this category low ({confidence}%).
insight.dupsText: {size} of identical content. {count} extra copies are marked while originals are kept.
insight.staleText: Every file in {names} has not changed for over a year; deleting them is very likely safe.

summary.nothing: No files to clean were found on your system.
summary.text: {size} of junk found in total ({count} files). AI safely recommends {recommended}. The remaining {rest} needs your approval.

note.recycleUnreadable: The Recycle Bin could not be read
note.recycleWarn: Once emptied, the files cannot be recovered
note.dupGroups: {count} duplicate groups · only the original of each group is kept

guard.root: The root folder cannot be deleted

err.revealNotInScan: This path is not part of the current scan

prev.title: Cleanup preview
prev.text: Nothing was changed. This only shows what would happen.

clean.title: Start the cleanup?
clean.text: The selected files go through the safety gate before anything is processed.
clean.warnDelete: Permanent delete is selected. Files will not be quarantined and cannot be restored.
clean.safeNote: Files are moved to quarantine; you can restore them at any time.
clean.skipped: {count} files were skipped (locked or protected path). See the list below for details.
clean.restorable: Files are in quarantine. You can restore them from the Quarantine tab.

rule.noScan: Run a scan first; then I can tell which files can be deleted.
rule.safeList: You can safely clean {count} categories: {names}. That frees {size} with no risk of data loss. The remaining groups may contain personal files — delete those by selecting them.
rule.noSafe: No risk-free categories are left. Total junk is {size}; you can delete the rest after reviewing it.
rule.disk: {drive} is {percent}% full: {used} in use, {free} free. The scan found {junk} of junk; cleaning the risk-free part increases free space.
rule.trust: Safe categories: browser caches, the thumbnail cache, temporary files and crash dumps. Risky ones: old downloads, large files and duplicates — review those one by one.
rule.duplicates: {size} of duplicates found. Originals are kept; {count} extra copies can be deleted.
rule.noDuplicates: No duplicate files were found (turn on deep scan and try again if it was off).
rule.summary: Summary: {junk} of junk found, {safe} of it risk-free. Ask me “what can I delete?” and I can suggest category by category.
